title: Morgan Wallen Reveals 2027 Sand In My Boots Festival Lineup
summary: The three-day festival returns to Gulf Shores, Alabama, featuring Kings of Leon, Empire of the Sun, Ella Langley, and more.
body_markdown:
[Morgan Wallen](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/morgan-wallen) ’s Sand In My Boots Festival is returning to Gulf Shores, Alabama, May 21–23, 2027, with a star-studded lineup personally curated by the country superstar.


Following its inaugural edition in 2025, the three-day beachside festival returns with performances by Morgan Wallen,[Kings of Leon](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/kings-of-leon) ,[Ella Langley](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/ella-langley) , and others, bringing together artists from country, rock, hip-hop, electronic music, and more.


[Morgan Wallen Radio Curated by Morgan Wallen Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSandInMyBootsMorganWallenRadio)


To celebrate the lineup announcement, SiriusXM’s[Morgan Wallen Radio (Ch. 64)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/morgan-wallen-radio-siriusxm) will play music from featured artists starting Monday, November 2. Fans can also hear exclusive audio from Wallen discussing how he selected the performers, his favorite memory from the inaugural festival, and what he’s most excited about in 2027.


“One thing I’m looking forward to the most about bringing Sand In My Boots Festival back is being able to have new concepts on stage and trying to elevate the experience overall for the fans, myself and other artists on the bill,” Wallen said. “I think it’s going to be really top-notch and we’re going to try to do it even better this time.”


- **Related:[Listen to Ella Langley’s Small Stage Series Show in Denver](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/ella-langley-denver-concert)**


### Sand In My Boots Festival 2027 Lineup


Curated by Wallen in partnership with AEG Presents, the festival reflects his wide-ranging musical influences, bringing together favorite artists, close collaborators, and performers who have inspired him throughout his career.


Among the announced performers are:


- Morgan Wallen
- Kings of Leon
- Ella Langley


The SiriusXM lineup-day playlist also features music from Kygo, Empire Of The Sun, Nelly, Flo Rida, Gavin Adcock, Third Eye Blind, Koe Wetzel and many more.


See the[official Sand In My Boots Festival website](https://sandinmybootsfest.com/) for the complete confirmed lineup.


### Listen to Sand In My Boots Festival Artists on SiriusXM


Tune in to Morgan Wallen Radio on satellite channel 64 and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSandInMyBootsMorganWallenRadio) starting November 2 to hear music from artists featured in the festival celebration, including country favorites, rock anthems, hip-hop hits, and more.


Listeners can also hear Wallen share exclusive behind-the-scenes stories about curating the lineup, his favorite memories from the 2025 festival, and what fans can expect when the event returns next May.


### Sand In My Boots Festival 2027 Dates and Tickets


Sand In My Boots Festival takes place **May 21–23, 2027** , on the beaches of Gulf Shores, Alabama.


Festival passes go on sale **Friday, November 6 at 11am ET (10am CT)** . Fans must register in advance to access the sale at[sandinmybootsfest.com](https://sandinmybootsfest.com/) .


Hotel packages are already available, combining festival passes with accommodations and, depending on the package, transportation to the festival grounds. Additional options include merchandise and shuttle passes.
